Ell1 weighted balanced perturbation columns remain inside a simplex face and are independent; adding basis columns preserves contraction. Ellinfty triangular row perturbation has positive determinant magnitude and respects row-sum bounds. Endpoints (one or all active coordinates), every n>=2, and both fields are included. The finite exact-rational checker replays 238 instances but the proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The motivating 2022 work expressly classifies only the two-dimensional ell1 orbit example and proves merely dense availability of pilgrim points for general polyhedral spaces. A complete n-level face-order description on two canonical dual n-dimensional families supplies an exact previously unarticulated semigroup-dynamics classification; it simultaneously identifies all individual reachable sets, the topology of those sets, and the mutually reachable quotient. The cube case and the all-points-pilgrim phenomenon cannot be concluded from the published binary case or a generic dense-set result. The fact is natural, finite-dimensional, and structurally complete rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
